title: Better Theater
description: Character portraits float like ghosts in an oval around the screen, without blocking clicks. Players set their own portrait (emotion, mirror); the GM can add any image, spotlight a portrait or lower the curtain. Chat lines appear as speech bubbles. Players can raise their hand to ask for the floor (Alt+L or their portrait menu): the queue shows on portraits and in the players list, and the GM gives the floor or lowers hands. Replaces "Add to Stage" from Theatre Inserts. English and French.
